mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND retired_at IS NULL
SELECT category AS key, count(*) AS count FROM tb_wardrobe_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND retired_at IS NULL GROUP BY category
SELECT color AS key, count(*) AS count FROM tb_wardrobe_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND retired_at IS NULL GROUP BY color ORDER BY count DESC, color ASC

SELECT s.style AS key, count(*) AS count FROM tb_wardrobe_item i CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(i.styles) AS s(style) WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.retired_at IS NULL GROUP BY s.style ORDER BY count DESC, s.style ASC
SELECT status AS key, count(*) AS count FROM tb_wardrobe_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND retired_at IS NULL GROUP BY status

SELECT item_id FROM tb_wardrobe_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND retired_at IS NULL AND (last_worn_at IS NULL OR last_worn_at < #{before}) ORDER BY last_worn_at ASC NULLS FIRST, created_at ASC, item_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND retired_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT retire_reason AS key, count(*) AS count FROM tb_wardrobe_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND retired_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY retire_reason ORDER BY count DESC, retire_reason ASC

SELECT 'CATEGORY' AS group_code, category AS code, count(*) AS count FROM tb_wardrobe_item GROUP BY category UNION ALL SELECT 'SUB_TYPE', sub_type, count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item GROUP BY sub_type UNION ALL SELECT 'COLOR', c.v, count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item i CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(array_prepend(i.color::text, i.sub_colors)) AS c(v) GROUP BY c.v UNION ALL SELECT 'PATTERN', pattern, count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item GROUP BY pattern UNION ALL SELECT 'ITEM_STATUS', status, count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item GROUP BY status UNION ALL SELECT 'SEASON', s.v, count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item i CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(i.seasons) AS s(v) GROUP BY s.v UNION ALL SELECT 'STYLE', s.v, count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item i CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(i.styles) AS s(v) GROUP BY s.v UNION ALL SELECT 'RETIRE_REASON', retire_reason, count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item WHERE retire_reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY retire_reason
